description: This file provides support for the TogetherAI platform's chat completion endpoint, including configuration classes and parameter mapping, extending openai-compatible interfaces.

classes.name: TogetherAIConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for TogetherAI models, extending OpenAIGPTConfig, with support for checking model features and mapping parameters.

methods.name: list get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of supported OpenAI parameters, conditionally removing some if the model does not support certain features.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps model parameters to OpenAI API format, removing 'response_format' if it equals {'type': 'text'}.

ctags.name: map_openai_params
ctags.signature: ( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
